resources.string: This panel is rendered from a single Kotlin Multiplatform / Compose Multiplatform codebase — one UI, two targets: an IntelliJ Platform plugin and a VS Code extension.
Platform differences go through a Bridge, not branching logic — native look and feel comes from Jewel inside IntelliJ, and matches VS Code's own theme in its webview.
Requires the vibe-action CLI, installed and available on PATH.
Vibe Action's configuration is a single YAML file, edited directly.
Clears all vibe-action cache. Safe to run anytime.
Detailed information about the vibe-action CLI application.
